title: Reload a handheld carton-sealing tape gun: roll past the hub detent, leader round the tension roller, out past the blade
instruction: Load the new roll into the tape gun so it is ready to tape a carton.
context: Hand packers and packagers (O*NET 53-7064.00; 645,210 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023) reload carton-sealing tape guns many times a shift. A wrongly loaded gun (roll turned over, leader over the roller instead of round it, guard shut on a leader too short to grab) jams or tapes adhesive-side up. The instruction gives none of the steps.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left), heights above the bench top. Tape gun (0.40 kg, free on the bench) lying on its side: dark side plate 16 (x) x 25 (y) x 0.6 cm at x 20-36, y -12 to 13; black handle 10 x 3 x 3.5 cm at x 29, y 16. Hub: steel, 6 cm across, 4.6 cm tall, at x 28, y 2.2, with a detent collar of three steel tabs reaching 4.5 cm from its axis, 2.4 cm up (12 N spring preload, 2 cm travel). Tension roller: black, 1.8 cm square section twice turned 45 deg (12.7 mm to the corners), 3 cm tall, at x 23.5, y -5 on a steel arm pivoted at x 24.7, y -7.5 (6 N spring). Nose: 2.5 x 2.7 x 3.4 cm at x 22.5-25, y -8.8 to -11.5, its outer face at x 22.5; steel blade strip on its front end, edge at y -11.8. Blade guard: red plate 4.4 x 0.2 x 3 cm hinged on a vertical axis at x 21.85, y -8.6, lying over the nose face (sprung shut, holds open past 45 deg). New roll: tan tape, 12 cm across, 7.6 cm core, 4.8 cm wide, 0.30 kg, lying flat face up at x 20, y -24. Leader: 8 tan links 2 x 0.2 x 4.4 cm (20 g each) hinged end to end, wound round the roll, its end carrying a blue 1.4 x 0.6 x 3.2 cm folded tab stuck to the roll.
scoring: Measured in the gun's frame. Seated: the roll pushed past the detent (collar 3 mm or more down), its centre within 8 mm of the hub axis and 4 mm of the seat height, axis within 5 deg of the hub's, tape face out (as packed). Under the roller: a stretch of links 2-6 with its centreline within 16 mm of the roller axis, on the roller's outer side (away from roll and nose). Score 0, latched, if the gun, the roll or the leader end drops 5 cm below the bench top (off the bench). Otherwise 0 unless seated. Then: 0.3; plus 0.3 leader under the roller; plus 0.2 adhesive side (each link's marked face) of the last two links facing away from the nose within 37 deg; plus 0.2 leader end 5-25 mm past the blade edge with the last link along the nose face (within 4.5 mm), guard shut (6 deg or less), no gripper within 2 cm of roll, last link, guard or gun, and all still (1 cm/s). All but the drop are read at the last step, so a misrouted or short leader can be redone. 1.0 held for 1 s ends the run.
reset_notes: Take the roll off the hub (press the detent collar back up), rewind the leader onto the roll and stick its tab down, lay the roll face up at its mark, shut the guard.
fidelity: Rigid boxes; roll and hub 12-sided. The leader is 8 rigid hinged links (no stretch). Past the detent the roll turns freely on its hub (it cannot come off), so drawing the leader pays it off the roll, up to its 8 links. The tab is welded to the roll until a hand reaches it. The detent is a preloaded spring collar a rule drops once pushed 3 mm. The tension roller is on a sprung arm but does not spin; the leader slides round it. No cutting.
